# references/

Reference material the LLM cites when analyzing bills and drafting letters: federal laws, 50 state-law packs, CPT/HCPCS code references, a national Medicare fee-schedule lookup, NCCI unbundling pairs, a billing glossary, statute-of-limitations data, and supplemental guides for Hospital Price Transparency MRF formats, SPD parsing, IRS 990 review, and state DOI portals.
